finding: Kubernetes StatefulSet restart semantics can restart the ClayVerse application container inside the same Pod, while Kata maps the Pod sandbox to the VM. Therefore an in-place container restart cannot satisfy ClayVerse Tier-2 full-appliance recovery, which requires replacement of the whole Pod/Kata sandbox/VM.
primary_evidence: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/apps/stateful-set-v1/ — StatefulSet Pod template restartPolicy only allows Always
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/ — kubelet restartPolicy restarts replacement containers inside the same Pod/node
https://github.com/kata-containers/kata-containers/blob/main/docs/design/virtualization.md — CRI Pod Sandbox maps to a VM; container maps to a process in the VM

canonical_delta.contract_change: Container restart inside an existing VM/microVM is not Tier 2; external fail-closed orchestration must delete/replace the whole Pod/Kata sandbox/VM and prove identity/state/replay invariants.
canonical_delta.template_change: StatefulSet is explicitly only the workload/isolation profile and marks external-full-sandbox-required / in-place-container-restart:not-tier2.
canonical_delta.test_change: Regression prevents restartPolicy Never/OnFailure pseudo-fixes and requires the full-sandbox replacement contract.
